claim_boundary: Single-sequence internal kinematic/geometric evaluation from monocular pseudo-labels and prescribed ball paths.

definition.predicted_interaction: Earliest frame with minimum ball-center to annotated target-toe distance in the fixed annotated_frame +/- 4 frame window.
definition.correct_foot_association: Target foot is strictly closer to the ball than the opposite foot at the annotated frame.

definition.support_interval: Annotated kick frame - 8 through kick frame + 2.
definition.support_foot: Foot opposite the annotated kick foot.
definition.floor_proxy: Depth of ankle/toe keypoint below the fixed 0.012 m threshold.

smoothness.definition: Forward finite difference of order n multiplied by fps^n; root RMS uses Euclidean XYZ magnitude, joint RMS pools all frames and 29 DoF.

definition.ground: Maximum depth of transformed G1 foot-mesh vertices below Z=0.
definition.ball_foot: Nearest transformed target-foot mesh vertex to ball center minus 0.11 m radius; vertex-sampled proxy, not exact triangle distance.

self_collision.reason: The rendering scene disables/filters relevant collision pairs; no robust non-adjacent mesh self-distance implementation is present.
